sloka: शब्दश्च सुमहांस्तेषां नर्दतामभिधावताम् ।श्रूयते तुमुले युद्धे न रूपाणि चकाशिरे ।। ६.५५.२१ ।।।।
transliteration: śabdaśca sumahāṁsteṣāṁ nardatāmabhidhāvatām ।śrūyate tumule yuddhe na rūpāṇi cakāśire ।। 6.55.21 ।।।।

translations.english: As they were rushing over one another, terrific noise was heard, and no form was discernible.
